recognize_zh: 整片骨髓被單一形態的中型芽細胞取代，核質比極高、核形不規則或有摺痕、染色質細緻，偶見少量成熟小淋巴球，符合前驅 T 淋巴芽細胞白血病；確診需流式細胞儀（cytoplasmic CD3）。
features: Sheets of medium-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei round to irregular, some with convolutions or indentations
Finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Absence of cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Scattered small mature lymphocytes and rare residual myeloid elements; many smudged cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and largely replaced by a monotonous population of medium-sized blasts. The blasts have scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, round to irregular and occasionally convoluted nuclei, fine chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods are seen, and normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; lineage assignment as precursor T-lymphoblastic leukemia requires flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, TdT).

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and require flow cytometry showing CD19, CD79a, and CD22 rather than cytoplasmic CD3.
Minimally differentiated AML blasts also lack granules and need MPO/flow cytometry (CD13, CD33, CD117) to separate.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT-negative mature B cells.
